about_the_game:
Lighthaze World: Breathe, Rest, Repeat. (Original Video Game Soundtrack)

A relaxing reimaging album of music of Lighthaze World. Composed by Tweaklab, this album is your personal soundtrack to its serene landscapes, the very music Nym listens to while wandering its sun-dappled trails and quiet, misty valleys.

Each track is a carefully crafted atmosphere of ambient pads, gentle piano melodies, and organic textures that mimic the rhythm of a slow, mindful breath. It’s designed to dissolve stress and guide you into a state of deep calm. So, find a comfortable space, put on your headphones, and let the soundscapes of "Breathe, Rest, Repeat" transport you. Allow yourself to unwind, find your center, and remember the most important rhythm of all: just breathe, rest, and repeat.
